title: Cielos 80 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Developed by a highly successful Texas-based developer, these luxury properties in Los Cabos capture the essence of elegance and comfort. Carved into the hillsides of Palmilla Mountain, each home offers unmatched privacy and tranquility, with expansive views of the Sea of Cortez. Depending on the location, guests can also enjoy stunning views of white-water beaches, the Bay of Palmilla, lush golf courses, and the twinkling lights of downtown San Jose. These homes are designed to blend the natural beauty of Los Cabos with the comforts of modern living, creating a perfect retreat. What truly sets these properties apart is the unforgettable experience they offer. Whether celebrating milestone anniversaries, gathering with loved ones for holidays, or escaping for a peaceful getaway, every moment here becomes a treasured memory. With breathtaking vistas and the peaceful surroundings of Palmilla Mountain, this is where families and friends create stories to be shared for years to come. The balance of luxury and warmth ensures an extraordinary stay, leaving guests longing to return.
